in_text_mentions: Un-enhanced penile MRI (Fig. 2) revealed a polypoid intermediate signal mass on the ventral surface of the penile shaft, infiltrating fossa navicularis, penile urethra, and corpus spongiosum, sparing the corpora cavernosa.
